digest.component_or_area: live DC harness + rich-text reconciliation + contract testing
propositions: The live DC harness must be extended to assert rendered HTML via ?expand=renderedFields, validating that wiki markup (bold, heading, code-macro) renders correctly through Jira's real renderer, not just as wiki source.

A second reconcile pass against the live instance must demonstrate state-based echo-safety: a pushed rich body that decodes to an unchanged value must not trigger a re-push (upgrade-then-converge behavior).

Under a both-sides concurrent edit scenario (rebar-side AND Jira-side edits to the same description field after baseline convergence), the next pass must emit the rebar body (local-wins) and record a deduped outbound-field-conflict alert while preserving the remote value.
A bare Jira-only edit (without local change) must be suppressed as a conflict and mirrored inbound as Jira-wins, without raising a conflict alert.
A cross-repo contract test must pin the public signature and behavior of InboundMapper.normalize_rich_text to prevent breaking changes that would affect the agentic-dev-platform import.
The live test must run in the existing Docker-based DC harness CI job using existing skip markers and PAT provisioning, without requiring a new CI job.
